notes.title: 3rd person narrative horror MEGANAUT from the dev of Lorn's Lure gets a demo
notes.notes:
The developer of the exploration climbing game Lorn's Lure is working on a new game named MEGANAUT, a 3rd person narrative horror and now there's a demo available with Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/3rd-person-narrative-horror-meganaut-from-the-dev-of-lorns-lure-gets-a-demo/
